desc: Ideate and select the next-greater chain cost model with monotonicity enabling a two-pointer sweep.
Implement the full solution using strict next-greater, root-cost binary lifting, and two-pointer sweep.
Run sample tests and self-test (examples, edge cases, random brute-force) and report PASS/FAIL verdict.

Run a large n=100000 performance sanity check on the current solution (random, strictly increasing, strictly decreasing, all equal, and large values), verify formula-based expected counts for monotone/equal cases, and report runtime/memory.
Finalize the solution after passing correctness and performance checks.
